_format: Each dialogue is a list of nodes. Node: id, speaker (hero id | npc id | 'tide' | 'narrator'), face, text, optional next, optional choices [{text, next, set:{flag:value}, requires:{flag:value}, cost:{...}}]. Tile hooks: put dialogue:'<id>' on a tile. 'tide' text renders cold blue-green, lowercase, no portrait. Re-entry: a dialogue may be started at a node other than the first (f2_frogcatcher starts at 'return' on later visits); see story/triggers_act1.json. requires keys: a flag name (true/false, unset = false); oil_min: N (lantern oil plus oil flasks carried >= N); hero_up: <hero> (that hero has HP > 0); hero_down: <hero> (that hero is at 0 HP). A choice whose requires fail is hidden; every choice list keeps at least one choice visible in every state. Optional node field next_if: [{requires, next}] is checked in order before next (f4_tide_wakes node a). Optional node field action: give:<item> | start_fight:<monster> | start_escape. A node spoken by a hero who is down is voiced by the first other hero who is up (order wren, mags, ilsevar, brannoc); lines that only fit one hero are already gated by requires. Bubble limit: every text and choice text <= 80 chars (2 lines x 40) in EN and EL.

f2_singing.speaker: narrator
f2_singing.text: Faint singing rises from below. No words.

f2_singing.speaker: mags
f2_singing.text: Tell me that's one of you humming.

f2_singing.speaker: ilsevar
f2_singing.text: It's the water. It's... pleased with us.

f2_glass_door.speaker: narrator
f2_glass_door.text: Water stands upright in the doorway, still as glass.

f2_glass_door.speaker: brannoc
f2_glass_door.text: Water doesn't stand. It's not allowed.

f2_glass_door.speaker: wren
f2_glass_door.text: Something's holding it. Let's not ask what.

f3_grate_tam.speaker: tam
f3_grate_tam.text: Down where it's wet. It's nice. Is it supper?

f3_grate_tam.speaker: mags
f3_grate_tam.text: That's my brother. He came for the frogs.

f4_captain.speaker: dural
f4_captain.text: But the boy stays. My oath is to the cells.

choices.text: "Your Thane is gone. Your oath is done."

f4_captain.speaker: dural
f4_captain.text: ...Sixty years. I'll go and see for myself.

f4_captain.speaker: dural
f4_captain.text: If he lives, tell him Dural kept the watch.

f4_captain.speaker: dural
f4_captain.text: A comedian. We drowned those first.

f4_captain.speaker: narrator
f4_captain.text: The captain draws a blade that drips.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: narrator
f4_tam_cell.text: Tam hangs in chains, chin-deep in black water.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: tam
f4_tam_cell.text: Hey Maggie. The water says I can stay.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: tide
f4_tam_cell.text: warm ones. he is ours. leave him, or pay.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: mags
f4_tam_cell.text: Nobody's paying for nothing. Get him out.

choices.text: Wren burns lantern oil to drive the water back.
Brannoc dives and breaks the chain.
Mags dives and picks the chain lock.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: wren
f4_tam_cell.text: There. Take it. Choke on it.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: mags
f4_tam_cell.text: Hold your breath, Tam. And your tongue.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: tam
f4_tam_cell.text: Maggie... it's cold. Why's it cold?

f4_tam_cell.speaker: mags
f4_tam_cell.text: Because you're an idiot. Walk. I've got you.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: mags
f4_tam_cell.text: ...I'll come back for you, Tam. I swear.

f4_tam_cell.speaker: tam
f4_tam_cell.text: Okay Maggie. I'll be here. Always.

f4_tide_wakes.speaker: tide
f4_tide_wakes.text: but you take what is ours. so we take back.

f4_tide_wakes.speaker: tide
f4_tide_wakes.text: you leave him to us. good. but still you take.

f4_tide_wakes.speaker: narrator
f4_tide_wakes.text: The floor groans. The water starts to rise.

f5_elda_letter.speaker: narrator
f5_elda_letter.text: A letter, in a careful hand:

f5_elda_letter.speaker: narrator
f5_elda_letter.text: "Let the water come, love. We'll go up."

f5_elda_letter.speaker: narrator
f5_elda_letter.text: "I'd rather be cold with you than safe alone."

f6_elda_grave.speaker: narrator
f6_elda_grave.text: A grave under the glass dome. ELDA, it reads.

f6_elda_grave.speaker: narrator
f6_elda_grave.text: A plain silver ring rests on the stone.

f6_elda_grave.speaker: wren
f6_elda_grave.text: Someone down here will want it back.

f6_elda_grave.speaker: brannoc
f6_elda_grave.text: Rest easy, grandmother. Or whatever you are.

f7_grotto.speaker: tide
f7_grotto.text: swamp-child. you have always heard us.

f7_grotto.speaker: tide
f7_grotto.text: answer now. we will show you where the fire hides.

f7_grotto.speaker: ilsevar
f7_grotto.text: ...Oh. It's so much bigger than I thought.

f7_grotto.speaker: wren
f7_grotto.text: Ilsevar? Your eyes are doing a thing.

f7_grotto.speaker: ilsevar
f7_grotto.text: No. I've met you. You're just hungry.

f7_grotto.speaker: tide
f7_grotto.text: we can wait. we are very good at waiting.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: Live ones! And a dwarf. Shame about the beard.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: Mine's better. Sit. You want to know how we breathe.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: The Heartforge drives the engine. The engine drives the air.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: The Tide keeps the water off the forge. For a price.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: Lend me a spark, priestess? My anvil's cold.

choices.text: "We need every bit of this flame."

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: Ahh. Sixty years. Give me an hour.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: One more thing. Orrun's not dead.

f8_hessa.speaker: hessa
f8_hessa.text: And the Heartforge is almost out.

f10_seal.speaker: narrator
f10_seal.text: The Thane's seal lies on a cushion of black silk.

f10_seal.speaker: brannoc
f10_seal.text: Orrun's seal. My blood, in a way.

f10_seal.speaker: brannoc
f10_seal.text: Somebody has to clean up after him.

f10_seal.speaker: mags
f10_seal.text: Does this mean I curtsy now?

f10_seal.speaker: brannoc
f10_seal.text: No. That crown sank a keep once already.

f11_throne.speaker: orrun
f11_throne.text: One flame given. One floor spared.

f11_throne.speaker: orrun
f11_throne.text: Who comes? Elda? Is that you?

f11_throne.speaker: orrun
f11_throne.text: ...Her ring. She said we'd go up.

f11_throne.speaker: dural
f11_throne.text: My Thane. It is over. I kept the watch.

f11_throne.speaker: orrun
f11_throne.text: LIAR. They breathe. I made them breathe!

f11_throne.speaker: narrator
f11_throne.text: The water swirls. You remember a night that isn't yours.

f12_final.speaker: tide
f12_final.text: the last flame. give it, and we are full.

f12_final.note: If ilsevar_listened, Ilsevar steps forward first -> ending:hollow_king

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: Oi! Under the shelf! Mags? Mags Reedly?

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: mags
f2_frogcatcher.text: Hobb Rushwick. You owe me six coppers.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: Lift this and it's seven. Tam went down. Said the water sang to him.

choices.text: Mags and Wren heave the shelf.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: brannoc
f2_frogcatcher.text: Hngh. Dwarven shelving. Built to last. Unfortunately.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: mags
f2_frogcatcher.text: Hngh! Who builds shelves out of anvils?

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: Bless you lot! A potion. Barely licked. Call it seven coppers.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: mags
f2_frogcatcher.text: Barely. Fine, we're square. Now get out of here.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: Come back? I'll be right here! Not like I've anywhere to go!

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: You came back! The shelf's been lovely company. Heavy, but lovely.

choices.text: Mags and Wren heave the shelf.

f2_frogcatcher.speaker: hobb
f2_frogcatcher.text: Again? Fine. I'll just lie here and think about frogs.
